changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO request_payment_fee (fee_method_id, type, amount) SELECT id, 'WASTE', 0 FROM request_payment_fee_method WHERE request_type in ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_SURRENDER', 'PERMIT_REVOCATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' );
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM request_payment_fee WHERE fee_method_id IN ( SELECT id FROM request_payment_fee_method WHERE request_type in ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_SURRENDER', 'PERMIT_REVOCATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) ) AND type = 'WASTE' AND amount = 0;
